findings.evidence: Plan specifies a catalog-bound terminal-effect receipt and deterministic reapply, but the disposable spike used a toy schema and did not exercise EffectExecutor terminal replay or actual checkpoint CAS fault windows.
findings.root_cause: The revised plan specifies a plausible replay protocol, but the required crash spike does not validate the real multi-transition boundary or all mandated fault windows.

findings.evidence: Plan names SQLite v6 ownership and restore behavior, but the toy migration did not reopen active Runs or validate resolver failure modes; one fingerprint field is also assigned incompatible legacy and v6 meanings.
findings.root_cause: The durable design is specified, but the real migration/restore proof and versioned fingerprint semantics are incomplete.

findings.evidence: The plan now uses a closed three-kind union and projects only executable records as Provider tools.
findings.root_cause: Each capability kind now has distinct identity, projection, loading and execution semantics.

findings.evidence: The plan now defines bounded private InstructionContribution ingress and body-free public receipts/logs with frozen tests.
findings.root_cause: Typed private ingress and public redaction are explicit.

findings.evidence: Plan specifies incarnation fencing and atomic publication, but the toy dict spike did not cover the actual manager/registry path, changed schema, failed reconnect or partial-publication barriers.
findings.root_cause: The protocol is specified but its lifecycle/publication race proof is incomplete.

findings.evidence: Fixtures and textual oracles are frozen; CAP-3 picker selected the exact file but attachment/Skill trace readiness remained PARTIAL after Computer Use timeout.
findings.root_cause: The CAP-3 black-box readiness path is not yet fully observed.

findings.evidence: The plan now provides reversible exact-artifact prepublish validation, immutable download verification, promotion and complete 0.4.0 backout.
findings.root_cause: Publication is preceded by a reversible consumer gate and followed by explicit rollback.
